institutional_grant_share.label: Institutional grant/scholarship recipient share
institutional_grant_share.concept: published institution-funded grant/scholarship recipient share under source cohort definition

state_local_grant_share.label: State/local grant recipient share
state_local_grant_share.concept: published state/local grant or scholarship recipient share under source cohort definition

rules: A source-supplied evidence state controls interpretation when present.
Blank value without a source state is missing, never suppressed by inference.
Suppressed, unresolved, not-published, and missing are distinct from numeric zero.
Measure labels and grains must remain explicit in product responses.
Income-band net-price measures are published institutional averages and must never be presented as personalized aid estimates or adjusted for household size without a separate authoritative method.
Income-band net prices are population averages and must not be presented as personalized estimates or adjusted for household size without an authoritative method.
Federal Work-Study and state/local aid are not school-funded institutional aid.
